_comment: "Target card defending an attack with Herald in its name gets -2{p} this combat chain." NOT implemented, and deliberately empty rather than left as what was there: MODIFY_DEFENSE_VALUE amount -2 with no 'mod', which the compiler reads as ADD -- so a card printed as a penalty was raising the DEFENDING TOTAL by 2, helping the player it is aimed at. Two things are missing. (1) There is no primitive that modifies a specific object's {p} for a duration; MODIFY_ATTACK moves the attack total, and SET_BASE_POWER is permanent and unscoped. (2) The gate is on the ATTACK's name containing 'Herald'; it was authored as CARD_IN_ZONE zone:'defending' card_name:'Herald', which asks whether a DEFENDING card is named Herald -- the wrong side of the combat -- and CARD_IN_ZONE does not read 'card_name' anyway, so it was true whenever anything was defending. Worth flagging for whoever implements it: '-2{p} on a DEFENDING card' is inert under the current rules engine, since a defending card's {p} is never consulted; confirm the printed text against a physical card before building a primitive for it.
